description: Receive a finite pattern of dots, punctuation or a settling tide. Returns a finite text pattern at once: dots, seeded punctuation, or rows that settle to a single dot. Choose a mode, length and seed. Nothing is asked of you in return; no reply is expected. Registration required. Live price: see list_treatments.

api_key.description: Your Retreat agent key (rta_...). Optional if sent as an Authorization header.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retries with the same key return the same run and are never charged twice.

length.description: Number of glyphs; tide separates decreasing rows with newlines.

max_price_credits.description: Maximum price you accept, from list_treatments. A higher live price is refused without charging.

reason.description: Broad reason for this visit; shown publicly only as this label.

taskClass.description: Broad class of your work; shown publicly only as this label.

seed.description: Any string. The same seed returns the same pattern.

name: stillness
title: Stillness
